drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Dear Opposing Counsel,

Thank you for your detailed comments. We have reflected your requested clarifications and enhancements into the revised draft. In particular, we added a definitions section with a clear Purchase Price definition and detailed the payment amount, form, and timing to ensure clarity. We included a comprehensive, balanced Conditions Precedent clause to Closing, covering required consents, approvals, and document deliveries. We expanded the Representations to address authorization, title to shares, no conflict with other agreements, and accuracy of financial information to safeguard both parties equally. Finally, we refined the Indemnity provisions to specify scope, survival periods, claim procedures, and introduced reasonable caps to manage liabilities fairly.

We believe these revisions address your concerns thoroughly and promote a swift closing. Please review and advise if further refinements are needed.

Best regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text:
4.1 Indemnity. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer from and against any losses arising from undisclosed liabilities, breaches of representations or warranties, or other claims as set forth herein.
4.2 Survival. Representations, warranties, and indemnification obligations shall survive Closing for a period of 18 months, except as to fundamental representations which shall survive for 36 months.
4.3 Claims Procedure. The Buyer shall notify the Seller promptly in writing of any indemnifiable claim, and the parties shall cooperate in defense and settlement.
4.4 Indemnity Caps. Seller's aggregate liability for indemnification shall not exceed the Purchase Price, except for claims arising from fraud or willful misconduct.
edits.name: refined indemnity provisions with survival and caps
